reference_role: Inspiration for new character; canonical generated Idle strip used for later actions
Idle: Create a NEW ORIGINAL pixel-art game character inspired by the supplied reference image (reference for clothing and mood, not an edit target): youthful freckled boy, dark brown bowl-cut hair, tan open jacket with dark blue collar, cream/red striped shirt, dark navy pants, grey-white sneakers. Friendly determined expression. For Upside Run, an eerie 1980s sci-fi endless runner. TRUE crisp low-resolution pixel art, strongly limited palette, simple intentional pixel clusters, dark pixel outlines, NO antialiased illustration, no painterly details. Side-facing RIGHT with slight 3/4 face, full body, consistent proportions about 3.5 heads tall. Deliver a production IDLE animation strip with EXACTLY FOUR fully separated full-body poses in ONE HORIZONTAL ROW, equal invisible-width cells, same scale and foot baseline, slight breathing changes only. Keep jacket, hair, face and clothes identical in all four. Each figure should occupy only the central 55% of its quarter of the image: large TRANSPARENT gaps between characters, transparent generous top and bottom margins. Absolutely no labels, no grid lines, no background, no ground, no shadows, no accessories, no flashlight. Do not let any pixels touch a neighboring pose. Genuine RGBA transparency. This strip establishes the canonical design for subsequent animation strips.
Walk: Use the supplied pixel-art strip as the CANONICAL character identity. Create a WALK CYCLE strip of EXACTLY SIX poses in ONE horizontal row on genuine RGBA transparency. Keep EXACTLY the same boy: rounded brown haircut, freckles, tan jacket with blue collar, red/cream striped shirt, navy trousers, grey-white sneakers, same face, same proportions and limited pixel palette. Facing RIGHT. Actual grounded walking mechanics, alternating left/right leg contact, down, passing and up phases; clear differences in leg position and opposite arm swings, feet near a CONSISTENT baseline, no running leap and no floating jump. All six same scale about 3.5 heads tall. Strict crisp pixel art matching reference, no blur. Equal invisible cell widths, each pose narrow within its sixth of canvas and at least 40% of each cell left transparent. Large gaps between figures, transparent top/bottom margins, no touching poses. No labels, no grid, no background or ground/shadows. Fully contained limbs. This cycle will be played faster as an endless-runner jog, so it must visibly cycle and not look like six copies of one pose.
Jump: Canonical identity reference: the supplied boy pixel-art strip. Draw EXACTLY THREE JUMP poses in one horizontal transparent strip: upward jump with knees slightly bent; airborne apex with knees tucked; descending with legs preparing to land. Face RIGHT. Same haircut, freckles, tan jacket with blue collar, striped cream/red shirt, navy pants, grey-white shoes, exact same character proportions and pixel palette as reference. All sprites same drawing scale. Sprite feet may differ in pose but center of torso consistently placed. Genuine crisp pixel art, clear dark pixel outline, limited colors. Equal invisible thirds, each complete figure wholly centered within its own third, VERY large transparent gaps, no limb near cell borders. No floor, no labels, no guide lines, no background, no blur, no extra objects. Fully transparent RGBA background. Only three poses, one row.
Slide: Canonical identity: supplied pixel-art boy. Create EXACTLY THREE low SLIDING poses facing RIGHT, one horizontal row on true transparent RGBA. Keep same dark brown bowl-cut hair, freckles, tan jacket with blue collar, cream/red striped shirt, navy trousers and grey-white sneakers. One leg extended forward, other tucked, body reclined LOW close to floor level, both hands safely near body. Three slight variations of the same held slide (not standing up), same foot/hip contact baseline, same drawing scale and head size as canonical strip. Crisp pixel art, limited palette, intentional clusters, no blurry outlines. Each complete pose centered in one invisible third of canvas with very wide transparent gaps; nothing touches another pose or canvas edge. No dust, no effects, no ground, no labels, no grid, no background. Full body uncropped.
Hurt: Canonical character identity is the supplied boy pixel-art strip. Create EXACTLY THREE HURT reaction frames in ONE horizontal row: flinch with shoulders recoiling, stronger recoil with one foot bracing, recovering balanced pose. Facing RIGHT, same exact tan/blue jacket, red cream striped shirt, navy pants, grey-white sneakers, brown bowl cut, freckles and face proportions as reference. Mild non-graphic video game damage reaction, no blood, no wounds, no stars or effects. Full complete figures, consistent head size and drawing scale, same ground baseline. Crisp limited-palette pixel art. Equal invisible thirds with very large transparent gaps around every figure, no touching or clipping. True RGBA transparent background, no floor, no text, no grids.
Death: Canonical character identity: supplied boy pixel-art strip. Draw a NON-GRAPHIC cartoon game defeat animation with EXACTLY THREE full-body poses in ONE horizontal row: losing balance seated, collapsing onto side, finally lying on side with eyes closed. Face oriented RIGHT. Same brown rounded haircut and freckles, tan jacket with blue collar, cream/red striped shirt, navy pants and grey-white sneakers. Same head size, same drawing scale and limited pixel palette as reference. No injuries, no blood, no gore, no effects. Crisp deliberate pixel art. Each pose wholly inside one invisible third, wide transparent gaps sufficient for horizontal lying pose, transparent margin on all canvas edges. No touching figures, no floor, no shadows, no text, no grid. Genuine RGBA transparent background.

Strong readable compact diamond-like silhouette. Crisp pixel clusters, limited palette, no blur, no fog, no broad glow, no ground, no cast shadow, no text, no UI, no multiple variants. Centered fully within canvas with generous truly transparent alpha margin on all sides. Transparent background. Designed to read at 24-32 screen pixels.
